data.name: Feed from Fury
data.description: A raging cannibal is empowered by eating her enemies during combat. When a raging cannibal confirms a critical hit against a creature of the same creature type as herself with her bite attack while raging, she gains %1 temporary hit points. These temporary hit points stack with other temporary hit points gained from this ability but not with those from other sources. These temporary hit points fade after %2 minutes.|BarbarianLVL|BarbarianLVL*10
